trigger.description: A Rust source that git reports as changed has an unbalanced brace, an unterminated declaration or an unbalanced macro brace group, so the lexical symbol extractor cannot build its symbols. `ee workspace hygiene` lists the code, without its message, in data.symbolRiskSummary.degradedCodes. A context pack with changed-symbol boosting reports the same failure as symbol_index_stale.
